title: Nightly Pirate Cinema
description: The official modpack for the Nightly Pirate Cinema server.
body:
# Nightly Pirate Cinema Official Modpack

The **Nightly Pirate Cinema Official Modpack** is the recommended pack for players joining the **Nightly Pirate Cinema Minecraft server**. It brings together all core mods used by the community so players can install everything needed for the intended server experience in one place.

This pack is designed to make setup easier, improve compatibility between required mods, and provide a more consistent experience for all players. It can also be used in **single-player** if you want to explore the same mod setup outside the server.

## What this modpack includes

This modpack focuses on the mods needed for the Nightly Pirate Cinema experience, including features such as:

- **In-game computers and automation** with **CC: Tweaked**
- **Furniture and decorative content** with **MrCrayFish’s Furniture – Refurbished**
- **Animated content support** through **GeckoLib** and **playerAnimator**
- **Immersive audio enhancement** with **Sound Physics Remastered**
- **Web and screen-based features** with **MCEF** and **WebDisplays**
- Additional required libraries and dependencies for proper compatibility

## Why download this pack?

- Makes joining the **Nightly Pirate Cinema server** quicker and easier
- Ensures you have the correct required mods for compatibility
- Reduces confusion by keeping the server mod setup in one maintained pack
- Can also be used for **single-player worlds** with the same mod environment

## Important information

- This pack is intended for **Forge 1.20.1**
- Some mods may still need to be installed externally through your modloader, depending on your setup
- This modpack is maintained and distributed by the **Nightly Pirate Cinema community**

## Included mods

- CC: Tweaked
- Stage Equipment Furnitures *(may need to be installed externally with your modloader)*
- Framework *(may need to be installed externally with your modloader)*
- GeckoLib
- MCEF
- MrCrayFish’s Furniture – Refurbished
- playerAnimator
- Sound Physics Remastered
- WebDisplays

By downloading and using this modpack, you are also supporting the creators and maintainers of the included mods.

**The Nightly Pirate Cinema community does not make any profit from downloads of this pack.**
